en_title: Take-Two Boss Strauss Zelnick on GTA 6 Expectations, GTA Online, and the Decade to Come
cn_title: Take-Two老板Strauss Zelnick谈对《GTA6》的预期、《GTA Online》及未来十年
opus_summary: 距离《GTA6》发售还有10天，Take-Two表示其预购表现远超公司最初预期。Strauss Zelnick称游戏不会再次延期，并表示将继续支持《GTA Online》。他还认为，《GTA6》即将发售可能影响了《NBA 2K27》的表现。

paragraphs.en: 10 days out from the release of GTA 6 , Strauss Zelnick tells me he’s feeling “optimistic.” It might be the understatement of the century. Reporting its second quarter fiscal year 2027 results tonight, Take-Two said preorders for Rockstar’s next game are tracking “far in excess” of the company’s initial expectations. “We know that the numbers will speak for themselves soon enough,” the Rockstar parent company added.
paragraphs.cn: 距离《GTA6》发售还有10天，Strauss Zelnick告诉我，他感到「乐观」。这或许是本世纪最轻描淡写的一句话。Take-Two今晚公布2027财年第二季度业绩时表示，Rockstar下一款游戏的预购表现「远远超出」公司最初的预期。这家Rockstar母公司补充道：「我们知道，数字很快就会说明一切。」

paragraphs.en: Or, as Zelnick put it to me during a phone interview, “I'm looking forward to the launch.”
paragraphs.cn: 或者用Zelnick在电话采访中对我说的话来说：「我很期待游戏发售。」

paragraphs.en: GTA 6 is expected to be the biggest entertainment launch of all time, surpassing any movie or video game before it in terms of sales and money made. There are concerns it might not just crash the PlayStation Store, but jam up the internet, given so many millions across the world are expected to download the whopping 212GB that make up Rockstar’s surefire hit.
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA6》预计将成为有史以来规模最大的娱乐作品首发，在销量和收入方面超越此前的任何电影或电子游戏。有人担心它可能不只是让PlayStation Store崩溃，还会堵塞互联网，因为预计全球将有数百万人下载Rockstar这款注定大获成功的游戏，其下载量高达212GB。

paragraphs.en: Still, GTA 6, like all video games these days, is beset by threats from all sides. The recent explosion in AI-fueled game clones and PS5 jailbreaks has raised the chances of GTA 6 turning up on PC before Rockstar has had a chance to release it officially. But what can Take-Two do about it?
paragraphs.cn: 尽管如此，《GTA6》和当今所有电子游戏一样，面临着来自各方的威胁。近期，借助AI制作的游戏仿制品和PS5越狱大量涌现，这增加了《GTA6》在Rockstar有机会正式推出PC版之前就出现在PC上的可能性。但Take-Two能对此做些什么呢？

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, all eyes are on Rockstar to see what happens after GTA 6 comes out, after its developers recently insisted its next game won’t take another eight years to make . Yes, it really has been eight years since Red Dead Redemption 2 came out.
paragraphs.cn: 与此同时，所有人都在关注Rockstar，想看看《GTA6》推出后会发生什么。此前，其开发人员最近坚称，下一款游戏的开发不会再花八年时间。没错，距离《荒野大镖客：救赎2》发售确实已经过去八年了。

paragraphs.en: In the interview below, we touch on all these topics and more, joke about yet another potential GTA 6 delay, and learn that GTA 6 is so popular it might have even caused sales of Take-Two’s own NBA 2K27 to miss expectations .
paragraphs.cn: 在下面的采访中，我们谈到了所有这些话题以及更多内容，开玩笑说《GTA6》可能再度延期，还了解到《GTA6》如此受欢迎，甚至可能导致Take-Two自家游戏《NBA 2K27》的销量未达预期。

paragraphs.en: IGN: Finally, after a decade of development, delays, ups and downs, GTA 6 is coming out. I'm just wondering, Strauss, how does it feel right now?
paragraphs.cn: IGN：历经十年的开发、延期和起起落落，《GTA6》终于要发售了。我想问问，Strauss，你现在感觉如何？

paragraphs.en: Strauss Zelnick: Optimistic. I'm looking forward to the launch.
paragraphs.cn: Strauss Zelnick：乐观。我很期待游戏发售。

paragraphs.en: IGN: Normally I'd ask you if you if there was a risk of GTA 6 being delayed. I've had conversations with you in the past that I'm guessing you can be pretty confident this time it's not going to be delayed again.
paragraphs.cn: IGN：通常我会问你《GTA6》是否有延期的风险。过去我和你聊过这个话题，我猜你这次应该可以相当有信心地说，它不会再延期了。

paragraphs.en: Strauss Zelnick: It’s not going to be delayed again.
paragraphs.cn: Strauss Zelnick：它不会再延期了。

paragraphs.en: IGN: There's a line in the financials about Rockstar continuing to support GTA Online with new content and ongoing events for its vast community. I'm just curious what impact you forecast GTA 6 having on GTA Online when the game comes out? What are your expectations about GTA Online from next week onwards?
paragraphs.cn: IGN：财报中有一句话提到，Rockstar将继续通过新内容和持续开展的活动，为《GTA Online》的庞大社区提供支持。我很好奇，你预计《GTA6》发售时会对《GTA Online》产生什么影响？从下周开始，你对《GTA Online》有什么预期？

paragraphs.en: Strauss Zelnick: We intend to keep supporting GTA Online and it has been very successful. It's been very resilient. It has continued to grow over the years, so we feel very good about it.
paragraphs.cn: Strauss Zelnick：我们打算继续支持《GTA Online》，而且它一直非常成功。它展现出了很强的韧性。这些年来它持续增长，所以我们对它感觉非常好。

paragraphs.en: IGN: There's another line about preorders for GTA 6 tracking far in excess of your expectations, and you say the numbers will speak for themselves soon enough. Do you make any preparations to try and ensure a smooth launch for your customers? Is GTA 6 so big you might actually crash the internet? Do you do anything around that to try and prevent any problems there?
paragraphs.cn: IGN：还有一句话提到，《GTA6》的预购表现远远超出你们的预期，而你们说数字很快就会说明一切。你们会做哪些准备，来尽量确保消费者在游戏发售时获得顺畅的体验吗？《GTA6》的规模是否大到真的可能让互联网崩溃？你们会为此做些什么，尝试防止出现任何问题吗？

paragraphs.en: Strauss Zelnick: We are very focused on that and we intend to do the very best we can to have a smooth delivery experience for all of our customers.
paragraphs.cn: Strauss Zelnick：我们非常重视这一点，并打算竭尽全力，让所有消费者都能顺利获取游戏。

paragraphs.en: Hannah Sage (EVP, Finance and Chief Accounting Officer): And the preload starts tomorrow in an effort to minimize that impact.
paragraphs.cn: Hannah Sage（财务执行副总裁兼首席会计官）：而且预载将于明天开始，以尽量减小这种影响。

paragraphs.en: IGN: There was a very interesting recent interview of senior Rockstar developers in Bloomberg. They said the foundation was laid for faster development following GTA 6. I was wondering what your expectation is now with Rockstar? Do you believe Rockstar will be able to release more games faster than before? Will you continue to treat Rockstar as you have done with GTA 6, with the budget and giving them the time needed to create the game like this? What's your take?
paragraphs.cn: IGN：彭博社最近对Rockstar资深开发人员进行了一次非常有意思的采访。他们说，在《GTA6》之后加快开发速度的基础已经打好了。我想知道，你现在对Rockstar有什么期待？你认为Rockstar能够比以前更快地推出更多游戏吗？你会继续像对待《GTA6》一样对待Rockstar，在预算方面给予支持，并给他们制作这样一款游戏所需的时间吗？你怎么看？

paragraphs.en: Strauss Zelnick: I certainly will continue to support all of our labels in their quest to make the best entertainment experiences on earth. And each of our three labels has its own bespoke strategy and approach and I'm supportive of that.
paragraphs.cn: Strauss Zelnick：我当然会继续支持我们所有的发行厂牌，帮助他们追求打造世界上最好的娱乐体验。我们的三个发行厂牌各自都有专门制定的策略和方法，我对此表示支持。

paragraphs.en: We do think that the nature and velocity of the content we'll see from our iconic franchises, including GTA, will look dramatically different over the next decade. And that's really being driven by our industry leading commitment to releasing the highest quality entertainment, to reaching our players in new ways and in new places and trying to maintain engagement with our consumers post-launch.
paragraphs.cn: 我们确实认为，在未来十年里，我们旗下包括《GTA》在内的标志性系列所推出内容的性质和速度将发生显著变化。这确实是由我们在业内领先的承诺所推动的：推出最高质量的娱乐作品，以新的方式和在新的地方触达玩家，并努力在作品推出后维持消费者的参与度。

paragraphs.en: IGN: We've seen hackers using AI to clone games much faster than ever before, even try to jailbreak consoles. And there is some concern about this leading to potentially GTA 6 being made available on PC unofficially or places that you aren't releasing it. I was just wondering how much of a threat this is to your business? And, is there anything meaningful you can do about it?
paragraphs.cn: IGN：我们看到黑客利用AI以前所未有的速度仿制游戏，甚至尝试破解游戏主机。有人担心，这可能导致《GTA6》以非官方形式出现在PC或你们没有发布该游戏的平台上。我想知道，这对你们的业务构成了多大的威胁？你们能采取什么有意义的措施来应对吗？

paragraphs.en: Strauss Zelnick: I don't think it’s a financial matter, in terms of a threat to our business. I do think it’s a creative matter. It's important to everyone, our developers and our consumers alike, to deliver the experience Rockstar envisions. And at the same time, of course, we protect our intellectual property vigilantly. So we are focused on these concerns. We're not in the least cavalier about them. Technology is advancing quickly. And at the same time, I do think that pretty much everyone wants the Rockstar experience as Rockstar intended.
paragraphs.cn: Strauss Zelnick：就对我们业务构成的威胁而言，我不认为这是一个财务问题。我确实认为这是一个创意问题。呈现Rockstar设想的体验对所有人都很重要，无论是我们的开发人员还是消费者。与此同时，我们当然会警惕地保护自己的知识产权。所以我们很重视这些问题，绝不会掉以轻心。技术正在飞速发展。同时，我确实认为，几乎所有人都希望获得Rockstar所设想的Rockstar体验。

paragraphs.en: IGN: Related, last week Anthropic confirmed they took steps to block Claude from reverse engineering video games. I would assume you would welcome that. And would you like to see other AI companies like OpenAI do the same thing to prevent people from using these powerful AI models to clone your games?
paragraphs.cn: IGN：与此相关，Anthropic上周证实，他们采取了措施，阻止Claude对电子游戏进行逆向工程。我想你应该会对此表示欢迎。你是否也希望看到OpenAI等其他AI公司采取同样的措施，防止人们利用这些强大的AI模型仿制你们的游戏？

paragraphs.en: Strauss Zelnick: I think all companies should be protecting intellectual property, their own and everyone else's. And if you're in the intellectual property business, which Anthropic is and OpenAI is, then it seems ironic on the one hand to stomp on someone else's IP and hope that yours is protected.
paragraphs.cn: Strauss Zelnick：我认为所有公司都应该保护知识产权，包括自己的和其他所有人的。如果你从事知识产权相关业务，Anthropic和OpenAI都是如此，那么一方面践踏别人的知识产权，一方面又希望自己的知识产权受到保护，似乎很讽刺。

paragraphs.en: IGN: Your financials mention that NBA 2K27 came in below your forecast. What do you put that down to and how do you improve upon matters?
paragraphs.cn: IGN：你们的财报提到，《NBA 2K27》的表现低于你们的预期。你认为这是什么原因造成的，又打算如何改善？

paragraphs.en: Strauss Zelnick: I think the key point is that while below our forecast, NBA 2K27 is our second best release of NBA 2K in history. It's an immensely successful title. It sold 4 million units. And in launching more content than ever before for the rest of the year, we have expectations that the title will do even better than it already has done.
paragraphs.cn: Strauss Zelnick：我认为关键在于，尽管低于我们的预期，《NBA 2K27》仍是我们有史以来发售表现第二好的《NBA 2K》作品。这是一款极其成功的游戏，销量达到了400万份。在今年剩余时间里，我们将推出比以往任何时候都更多的内容，我们预计这款游戏的表现将比目前更好。

paragraphs.en: I do think that this timing may have affected performance so far. It has been a crowded period, and we do think that GTA 6 coming has had an influence on the consumer. That said, we're thrilled with how NBA 2K27 is performing.
paragraphs.cn: 我确实认为，这个时间点可能影响了游戏迄今为止的表现。这段时间竞争很激烈，我们也确实认为《GTA6》即将发售对消费者产生了影响。尽管如此，我们对《NBA 2K27》的表现感到非常高兴。

paragraphs.en: IGN: There's also a line there about Borderlands 4. It's now sold over 100 million units as a franchise. Congratulations for that. But there's a line about what lies ahead for this series. Is it your belief that Borderlands can meaningfully grow its audience and improve commercially? And if so, from your point of view, how can it achieve that?
paragraphs.cn: IGN：财报中还有一句话提到了《无主之地4》。《无主之地》系列如今的销量已经超过1亿份，恭喜你们。不过，财报中还提到了这个系列的未来。你是否认为《无主之地》能够显著扩大受众并改善商业表现？如果是的话，在你看来，它该如何做到这一点？

paragraphs.en: Strauss Zelnick: The answer is yes. It is a big hit franchise already and I think there's plenty more to come. I think if you ask the team at Gearbox, they are highly optimistic that there's a lot yet to be done and I do believe that there is a lot yet to be done. I'm very excited going forward about all things Borderlands.
paragraphs.cn: Strauss Zelnick：答案是肯定的。它已经是一个大获成功的系列，我认为未来还有很多值得期待的东西。我想，如果你去问Gearbox的团队，他们会非常乐观地认为还有很多事情可以做，而我也确实相信还有很多事情可以做。展望未来，我对与《无主之地》有关的一切都感到非常兴奋。
